name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3108: the second eye found the river-cannot-drain bug one layer down: backup refused any 0-row copy, which is right for a failed copy and wrong for a ring generation legitimately drained to nothing - so the moment one generation empties, every later apply dies at the backup step before the live file is touched. It now compares the copy to its SOURCE. Also narrowed the rotation race by re-checking each file immediately before its rewrite.
